Dutiful.name: Dutiful
Dutiful.description:
📜 You do what you signed up for: rules, procedures and promises made in uniform.

🏛️ Superiors trust you with responsibility, and you know the rules better than most.
⚠️ You follow orders and procedure even when they are wrong, and freeze when duty conflicts with what is right.
⚠️ Rule-breakers find you rigid.
🔀 If you are also Rebellious, you obey the rules you believe in and fight the rest.

📈 Grants: Hero Law +5
Dutiful.traitNarrativeEffects: The character is dutiful: they take their obligations seriously, follow procedure, know the rules and keep promises made in uniform; superiors trust them with responsibility. Weakness: they follow orders and procedure even when they are wrong, struggle when duty and conscience pull apart and seem rigid to rule-breakers. If the character is also Rebellious, they keep the rules they believe in and fight the rest. The narrator shows what the rules require; when to bend them is the player's decision.
